sections.title: Grammar — Present Simple vs Present Continuous
sections.titleUz: Grammatika — Present Simple va Present Continuous

exercises.instructionEn: Study the examples, then complete the rules.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI MISOL:

  John usually WEARS jeans and T-shirts.
     = Jon odatda jinsi shim va futbolka kiyadi.  (ODAT)

  John's WEARING a suit and tie today.
     = Jon bugun kostyum va galstuk kiygan.  (BUGUN, HOZIR)

BIR ODAM, BIR FE'L — IKKI ZAMON:
  'usually' bor  → PRESENT SIMPLE
  'today' bor    → PRESENT CONTINUOUS

TO'LDIRILADIGAN QOIDALAR:
  We use ............ to talk about habits and daily routines.
  We use ............ to talk about actions happening now,
  at the moment of speaking.

  = Odat va kundalik tartib haqida gapirish uchun ...... ishlatamiz.
    Hozir, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan ish haqida
    gapirish uchun ...... ishlatamiz.

items.textEn: We use ............ to talk about habits and daily routines.
items.whyUz:
ODAT va KUNDALIK TARTIB → PRESENT SIMPLE.
Misol: John usually WEARS jeans.
Belgilari: usually, always, often, sometimes, never,
every day, in his free time.

items.textEn: We use ............ to talk about actions happening now, at the moment of speaking.
items.whyUz:
HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan ish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
Misol: John's WEARING a suit today.
Belgilari: now, at the moment, at present, today.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the dialogue and repeat. Then, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni tinglang va takrorlang. So'ng berilgan so'zlar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI DIALOG (rasmda kafeda o'tirgan ikki ayol):

  A: Look at Pam! She's wearing a dress today!
  B: Oh, yes! She usually wears jeans and T-shirts.
     She looks nice in a dress!

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  A: Pamga qara! U bugun ko'ylak kiygan!
  B: Ha, rostdan! U odatda jinsi shim va futbolka kiyadi.
     Unga ko'ylak juda yarashadi!

DIALOG UCH GAPDAN IBORAT:
  1) BUGUN nima kiyganini aytish  → Present Continuous
  2) ODATDA nima kiyishini aytish → Present Simple
  3) Maqtash                       → 'looks nice in ...'

BERILGAN SO'ZLAR (ism / bugungi kiyim / odatdagi kiyim):
  John  / shirt and tie      / jumpers
  Ellen / shorts             / long skirts
  Tim   / jeans and trainers / a suit
  Donna / trousers           / dresses

DIQQAT — 'look nice IN + kiyim':
  'She looks nice IN a dress' — 'in' predlogi SHART.
  'look nice with a dress' XATO.

items.prompt: Pam / a dress / jeans and T-shirts (kitobdagi namuna)
items.question: Look at Pam! She's wearing a dress today!
items.answer: Oh, yes! She usually wears jeans and T-shirts. She looks nice in a dress!
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
'She's wearing' = hozirgi holat; 'She usually wears' = odat.

items.question: Look at John! He's wearing a shirt and tie today!
items.answer: Oh, yes! He usually wears jumpers. He looks nice in a shirt and tie!

items.question: Look at Ellen! She's wearing shorts today!
items.answer: Oh, yes! She usually wears long skirts. She looks nice in shorts!

items.prompt: Tim / jeans and trainers / a suit
items.question: Look at Tim! He's wearing jeans and trainers today!
items.answer: Oh, yes! He usually wears a suit. He looks nice in jeans and trainers!
items.whyUz:
'jeans' va 'trainers' — ko'plik → 'a' yo'q.
'a suit' — birlik → 'a' bilan.

items.question: Look at Donna! She's wearing trousers today!
items.answer: Oh, yes! She usually wears dresses. She looks nice in trousers!

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoa bo'lib ishlang. Navbatma-navbat ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab, gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko. Eng ko'p ochkoli jamoa g'olib bo'ladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'YIN SO'ZLARI (14 ta) — butun 7-unit lug'ati:
  jacket, snowy, boiling hot, what about, hot, enjoy,
  freezing cold, weather, cloudy, too tight, too long,
  sunbathing, temperature, season

QOIDALAR:
  • Ikki jamoaga bo'linasiz
  • Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'z tanlaysiz
  • O'sha so'z bilan TO'G'RI gap tuzasiz
  • Har bir to'g'ri gap — 1 ochko
  • Ko'p ochkoli jamoa g'olib

Quyida har bir so'z uchun namuna gap berilgan.

modelSentences.sentence: John is wearing a leather jacket today.
It's a snowy day in Prague.
What about these shoes? They're too expensive.
It's very hot and the sun is shining in Sydney.
Everyone is enjoying the good weather on the beach.
It's freezing cold and snowy in winter.
There are clouds in the sky. It's cloudy today.
I can't wear this shirt. It's too tight.
What do you think of this dress? — It's too long.
Sonia is sunbathing near the pool at the moment.
What's the temperature in Cairo today? — It's 25°C.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and fill in the gaps. Then, listen and check. Finally, act out similar dialogues about the other clothes you can see in the pictures.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring. So'ng tinglab tekshiring. Nihoyat, rasmlardagi boshqa kiyimlar haqida shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMLARDA TO'RT KIYIM:
  yashil ko'ylak (a green dress)
  qora kurtka (a black jacket)
  sariq jemper (a yellow jumper)
  qizil yubka (a red skirt)

DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):
  A: CAN I help you?
  B: Yes, PLEASE. I'm looking for a jumper.
  A: What colour WOULD you like?
  B: Yellow.
  A: HERE you are.
  B: Can I try it on, please?
  A: Yes, of course.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  A: Yordam bera olamanmi?
  B: Ha, iltimos. Men jemper qidiryapman.
  A: Qanday rangdagisini xohlaysiz?
  B: Sariq.
  A: Mana, oling.
  B: Kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi?
  A: Ha, albatta.

YANGI IBORA:
  Can I try it on? = Kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi?
  'try on' — kiyib ko'rmoq (frazali fe'l).
  Olmosh bilan faqat 'try IT on' (o'rtada).

lines.whyUz:
'Can I help you?' = Yordam bera olamanmi?
Do'konda sotuvchining odatiy birinchi gapi.

lines.textEn: Yes, 2) ............ . I'm looking for a jumper.
lines.whyUz:
'Yes, please.' = Ha, iltimos.
Taklifni QABUL QILISH: Yes, please.
RAD ETISH: No, thank you.

'What colour WOULD you like?' = Qanday rangdagisini xohlaysiz?
'would like' = xohlamoq (muloyim shakl).
'What colour DO you like?' — 'qanday rangni yoqtirasiz?' — boshqa ma'no.

'Here you are.' = Mana, oling.
Narsani birovga uzatganda aytiladi.
'Here it is' ham mumkin, lekin kitob 'Here you are' beradi.

lines.textEn: Can I try it on, please?

exercises.instructionEn: Finally, act out similar dialogues about the other clothes you can see in the pictures.
exercises.instructionUz: Nihoyat, rasmlardagi boshqa kiyimlar haqida shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMLARDAGI QOLGAN KIYIMLAR:
  a dress  — yashil
  a jacket — qora
  a skirt  — qizil

QOLIP O'ZGARMAYDI, faqat KIYIM va RANG almashadi.

DIQQAT — 'try on' bilan olmosh:
  Can I try IT on?    (birlik: dress, jacket, skirt, jumper)
  Can I try THEM on?  (ko'plik: trousers, shoes, jeans)

exercises.instructionEn: Use the plan below to write a postcard to a friend (40-60 words). Use the postcards in Ex. 7 as models.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi reja bo'yicha do'stingizga otkritka yozing (40–60 so'z). 7-mashqdagi otkritkalarni namuna qilib oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA:

  Dear + (do'stingizning ismi)
     Greetings from ...
     • Say where you are            — qayerda ekaningizni ayting
     • Say what the weather is like — ob-havo qandayligini ayting
     • Say what clothes you are wearing — nima kiyganingizni ayting
     • Say what you are doing now   — hozir nima qilayotganingizni ayting
     See you soon.
           Lots of love,
           (sizning ismingiz)

TALAB: 40–60 so'z.

NAMUNA: 49-betdagi uchta otkritka (Tom, Tracy, Pamela).

DIQQAT — BARCHA GAPLAR PRESENT CONTINUOUS'DA:
chunki HOZIRGI holat tasvirlanadi.
Faqat ob-havo sifat bilan aytilishi mumkin: 'It's very hot.'

structure.noteUz:
'Greetings from ...' — otkritkaning odatiy boshlanishi.
Bu 'Say where you are' bandini ham bajaradi.

structure.modelEn: I am on holiday here with my family.
The weather is fantastic. It's very hot and the sun is shining.
structure.noteUz:
'What's the weather like?' savoliga javob.
50-betdagi harorat so'zlaridan foydalaning.

structure.modelEn: I'm wearing a T-shirt, shorts and sandals.
structure.noteUz:
Present Continuous: 'I'm wearing ...'.
KO'PLIK kiyimda 'a' YO'Q: shorts, sandals.

structure.modelEn: At the moment I'm sitting in a café in Registan Square and I'm drinking green tea.

structure.noteUz:
'Lots of love' — yaqin do'st va oilaga.
Rejada aynan shu shakl berilgan.

structure.modelEn: Dear Aziz, Greetings from Samarkand! I am on holiday here with my family. The weather is fantastic. It's very hot and the sun is shining. I'm wearing a T-shirt, shorts and sandals. At the moment I'm sitting in a café in Registan Square and I'm drinking green tea. See you soon. Lots of love, Nilufar
structure.noteUz:
52 so'z — talab qilingan 40–60 oralig'ida.
Barcha gaplar hozirgi holatni tasvirlaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Uchta ingliz maqoli — ikkitasi OB-HAVO, biri KIYIM haqida.
Unit sarlavhasi ham birinchisidan olingan.

items.uz:
So'zma-so'z: Yomg'ir kelsin yoki quyosh chiqsin.

MA'NOSI: Ob-havo qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar;
har qanday sharoitda; nima bo'lsa ham.

ISHLATILISHI: va'da yoki qat'iyatni bildiradi.
  'I'll be there, come rain or shine.'
  = Nima bo'lsa ham, men u yerda bo'laman.

O'ZBEKCHA MUQOBILI: 'Har qanday holatda ham',
'Osmon uzilib tushsa ham'.

DIQQAT: 7-UNIT SARLAVHASI aynan shu maqol —
'Come Rain or Shine'.

items.en: March comes in like a lion and goes out like a lamb.
items.uz:
So'zma-so'z: Mart sherdek kirib keladi va qo'zichoqdek chiqib ketadi.

MA'NOSI: Mart oyining BOSHIDA ob-havo qattiq va shamolli
bo'ladi (sher kabi yovvoyi), OXIRIDA esa iliq va yumshoq
bo'ladi (qo'zichoq kabi muloyim).

Bu — Britaniyaning bahor ob-havosi haqidagi eski maqol.
Mart — qish va bahor chegarasi.

LUG'AT:
  a lamb /læm/ = qo'zichoq ('b' O'QILMAYDI)
  come in  = kirib kelmoq
  go out   = chiqib ketmoq
  like     = ...kabi, ...dek

O'ZBEKCHA O'XSHASHI: 'Mart — ola-quroq'.

So'zma-so'z: Kiyim odamni yasaydi.

MA'NOSI: Odam qanday kiyinsa, shunday baholanadi;
kiyim odamning taassurotini belgilaydi.

O'ZBEKCHA MUQOBILI:
  'Ot ko'rki — yol, odam ko'rki — kiyim'
  'Kishini kiyimiga qarab kutib olishadi'

DIQQAT — GRAMMATIKA:
  'Clothes' — DOIM ko'plik → fe'l ham ko'plikda: MAKE.
  'Clothes makes the man' XATO.
  'a clothe' degan so'z YO'Q.

Qarama-qarshi fikr ham bor:
  'Don't judge a book by its cover.'
  = Kitobni muqovasiga qarab baholama.

patterns.formula: X usually WEARS ... (odat)  ↔  X's WEARING ... today (hozir).
patterns.exampleEn: John usually wears jeans and T-shirts. John's wearing a suit and tie today.
patterns.exampleUz: Jon odatda jinsi shim va futbolka kiyadi. Jon bugun kostyum va galstuk kiygan.
patterns.explanationUz:
Bir odam, bir fe'l — ikki zamon.
Vaqt so'ziga qarang: usually → Simple;  today → Continuous.

patterns.formula: Look at + ism! He's/She's wearing + kiyim + today!
patterns.exampleEn: Look at Pam! She's wearing a dress today!
patterns.exampleUz: Pamga qara! U bugun ko'ylak kiygan!
patterns.explanationUz: Hayrat bildirish qolipi. 'Look at ...!' bilan boshlanadi.

patterns.exampleEn: She looks nice in a dress!

patterns.formula: Can I help you? — Yes, please. I'm looking for + kiyim.
patterns.exampleEn: Can I help you? — Yes, please. I'm looking for a jumper.
patterns.exampleUz: Yordam bera olamanmi? — Ha, iltimos. Men jemper qidiryapman.

patterns.formula: What colour would you like? — rang.  Here you are.
patterns.exampleEn: What colour would you like? — Yellow. — Here you are.
patterns.exampleUz: Qanday rangdagisini xohlaysiz? — Sariq. — Mana, oling.

patterns.formula: Can I try IT on, please? — Yes, of course.
patterns.exampleEn: Can I try it on, please? — Yes, of course.
patterns.explanationUz:
Olmosh bilan 'try IT on' — 'try on it' XATO.
Ko'plik uchun: 'try THEM on'.

patterns.formula: Otkritka rejasi: Dear → Greetings from → joy, ob-havo, kiyim, mashg'ulot → See you soon → Lots of love.
patterns.exampleEn: Dear Aziz, Greetings from Samarkand! It's very hot. I'm wearing a T-shirt and shorts. See you soon. Lots of love, Nilufar
patterns.exampleUz: Hurmatli Aziz, Samarqanddan salom! Juda issiq. Men futbolka va kalta shim kiyganman. Tez ko'rishguncha. Katta mehr bilan, Nilufar
patterns.explanationUz: 40–60 so'z. Barcha gaplar HOZIRGI holat haqida.
